# biobb_pytorch

### Introduction
Biobb_Pytorch is the Biobb module collection to create and train ML & DL models using the popular [PyTorch](https://pytorch.org/) Python library. Biobb (BioExcel building blocks) packages are Python building blocks that create new layer of compatibility and interoperability over popular bioinformatics tools. The latest documentation of this package can be found in our readthedocs site: [latest API documentation](http://biobb-pytorch.readthedocs.io/en/latest/).
